channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: XRP Ledger activates scoped account delegation, with one permission still risky
item.description: The XRP Ledger activated PermissionDelegationV1_1 on Oct. 8, letting account owners assign specific tasks to other accounts while retaining control of their main keys.

item.title: U.S. moves $1.01 billion in bitcoin tied to Bitfinex hack
item.description: The U.S. moved 12,267 BTC worth $1.01 billion from a Bitfinex seizure wallet to new addresses Thursday, with no exchange deposit or sale indicated.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support and disclosed $6 million for six races, as a Senate crypto bill stalls and its next steps remain uncertain.

item.title: Prysm fix sets up Ethereum’s 200M-gas Glamsterdam test
item.description: Prysm 7.2.1 changes validator defaults ahead of Ethereum’s Sepolia test at 200 million gas, making the capacity trial more representative while mainnet plans remain open.

item.title: Arbswap’s first-timer guide to swaps, liquidity and farming
item.description: Arbswap combines token swaps, pool liquidity and reward farming on Arbitrum; understanding how each step changes exposure helps first-time users choose what to do.

item.title: Fairshake commits $6 million to six House races
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for 2026 support and committed $6 million to six, as Senate crypto market rules remain stalled ahead of midterms.

item.title: FinCEN Withdraws Crypto Wallet and Mixer Proposals
item.description: FinCEN withdrew proposals on self-hosted wallets and crypto mixing, ending years of uncertainty while leaving future action on illicit finance open.

item.title: Zcash starts public test of 25-second blocks ahead of schedule
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 on its public testnet at block 4,465,026 on Oct. 4, cutting target spacing to 25 seconds and starting a test before a Nov. 5 mainnet target.

item.title: Bitget-linked wallets shield $3.9 million in Zcash
item.description: Bitget-linked wallets moved 2,746 ZEC, worth about $3.9 million, into Zcash’s Ironwood pool, obscuring later transfers while leaving entry data visible.

item.title: Polygon Withdrawals Put Treasury Liquidity on a Longer Clock
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals burn tokens before Ethereum releases them, leaving treasury teams to plan around checkpoint waits, a second transaction and uncertain timing.

item.title: A stalled Polygon withdrawal may be waiting for its Ethereum claim
item.description: A Polygon withdrawal can pause before its Ethereum claim is ready or while that claim awaits gas. Check each stage before retrying or choosing another route.

item.title: Why a rebasing token’s pool balance can look wrong
item.description: A rebasing token can change a pool’s live balance without a trade, while an AMM’s stored reserves lag; compare both before reading price or liquidity.

item.title: Five Steps to Fund a Polygon Wallet Before Minting
item.description: A Polygon collectible mint needs the right network, payment token and gas balance; these five checks help you choose a funding route and avoid a failed transaction.

item.title: Multi-Hop Swaps: How to Read the Route Before You Trade
item.description: A multi-hop swap routes one token through intermediate assets; compare its net output, fees, price impact and minimum received with a direct route before signing.

item.title: Blast will wind down as operating costs outrun revenue
item.description: Blast will wind down after saying network costs exceed revenue, while users face a weeklong withdrawal pause and an Oct. 26 deadline for its standard withdrawal interface.

item.title: Solana Swap Slippage: Set a Limit, Not a Price Target
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the worst output a Solana swap will accept; learn how it differs from price impact, how to size it and when a failed trade is the better result.

item.title: How Much ETH Should a Treasury Keep for Token Swaps?
item.description: A treasury’s ETH reserve should cover measured swap and approval gas under stressed conditions, with a separate buffer for timing, chain choice and operational delays.

item.title: Bridge the right assets before joining a Polygon pool
item.description: Before joining a Polygon pool, move the exact supported token to Polygon PoS, keep POL for gas, and confirm the pool’s network and token contract.

item.title: Why Avalanche Pool Prices Can Mislead Smart Contracts
item.description: A pool’s spot price describes its current balance, not a reliable market value; thin liquidity, trade size and oracle design can change what a contract should trust.

item.title: A token swap estimate is a quote, not a promise
item.description: A token swap estimate combines pool price, fees, route depth and slippage; checking those parts before signing shows what can change before on-chain settlement.
